label: Typical US diet
description: About 12% of energy from SFA and 300 mg/day cholesterol, as on the cards. Approximate NHANES/WWEIA pattern: 16% protein, 33% fat, 51% carbohydrate; soluble fiber about 5 g/day; plant sterols about 0.3 g/day.

label: Mediterranean-style (not keto)
description: Olive oil, nuts, legumes, fish, whole grains, vegetables. About 45% carbohydrate, 38% fat; SFA 8% of energy.

label: Keto: eggs, butter, bacon, cheese, steak
description: 4 large eggs scrambled in butter, bacon, cheese, steak, cream in coffee. 10% carbohydrate, 15% protein, 75% fat; about 29% of energy from SFA and 900 mg/day cholesterol.

label: Keto: olive oil, salmon, nuts, avocado
description: 2 eggs, olive oil on everything, salmon, nuts, cheese, avocado. About 22% of energy from SFA; 450 mg/day cholesterol.

label: Keto: bulletproof coffee (coconut oil + butter), ground beef
description: Coconut oil and butter in coffee twice a day, ground beef, cheese, 1 egg. About 38% of energy from SFA, mostly lauric and myristic acid.

label: Vegan keto: olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, psyllium
description: No animal foods. No dietary cholesterol; lots of soluble fiber and plant sterols.
